subject: Getting error in my first shiny app, fetching data using WDI function

messages.author: fe4c543cbc679123
messages.subject: Getting error in my first shiny app, fetching data using WDI function
parts:
Dear Friends,
I am trying to create my first shiny app. However, I am finding it too confusing because of the errors I am getting. Need your help please.

I want to create visualization for World Bank Development Indicators. I am attaching the indicators list herewith.
For the selected indicator, I should get the data table.  But it is not working out. I only see a dropdown list of indicators rather than selection list with the table.

Thanks for reading.

My UI.R is

indicators<-read.xlsx2("C:/Users/A561568/Downloads/WDI_April2013_CETS.xls", 1)

shinyUI(basicPage(
    selectInput("id1", "Indiactor-I", choices=levels(indicators$Series.Code), width="100%"),
    dataTableOutput('table1'),
    textOutput('text1')
))


My SERVER.R is

library(shiny)
library(WDI)
shinyServer(
    function(input, output) {
        data1 <- reactive(WDI(input$id1,country = "all", extra=T))
        output$table1<-renderDataTable(data1)
        output$text1 <- renderText({dim(data1)})
        
    })
